newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields keep falling on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields keep falling on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further on Monday at the daily auctions of Bulgaria's finance ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.77 and 4.59 percent, respectively, down from 0.82 and 4.68 percent at Friday's auctions and from Thursday's 0.84 and 4.79 percent.
Bids were received for a total of 40.173 billion lev worth of T-bills as the one-week issue was oversubscribed and the four-week undersubscribed.
The ministry approved bids for a total of 36.578 billion levs of paper.
The issues were offered with par values of eight billion levs and 35 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 35,000 million levs
Bids received 11,595 million levs 28,577.5 million levs
Avg price of bids 99.22 pct 95.61 pct
